options.request: Closed outer DTO: binding_ref, expected_revision decimal string, request_id UUID, design_json string. No raw root/caller/approval/digest authority. Inner JSON remains text until C1 guarded parse; do not deserialize inner doc into Value or DesignDoc first.
options.order: actual caller/binding -> outer shape/size -> C1 guarded parse -> semantic/ownership checks -> immutable candidate -> authorized install -> separately approved M04 save
options.load: HOST guarded parse raw file bytes before canonical projection; return validated canonical design_json and server revision/binding metadata. JS parses only validated representation under C1 numeric policy; raw disk baseline remains server-side.
options.lifetime: Revalidate binding/session/revision before install; late result cannot replace current owner. No UI raw digest accepted as persistence evidence.

options.recommendation: Alternative raw-payload preserving custom deserializer, separate scope
options.request: Need raw Tauri payload seam before any lossy typed/Value conversion; exact duplicate/unknown/numeric/limit behavior equivalent to C1.
options.limitation: Closed typed DTO alone insufficient; no global IPC rewrite without explicit envelope.
Already-lost unknown fields/duplicates/numeric lexemes cannot be recovered.
